name: woslicer-dx
description: Electron + TypeScript reimplementation of woslicerIII (BMS wav slicer), byte-compatible with the original .wos format and slicer DSP

scripts.typecheck: npm run gen:i18n && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.build:main: npm run gen:i18n && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node scripts/bundle-preload.js && node scripts/write-build-info.js
scripts.build:renderer: npm run gen:i18n && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-renderer-assets.js
scripts.build: npm run check:version && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.web: npm run bundle && node src/web/server.mjs dist/web
scripts.build:app: npm run gen:i18n && node scripts/tauri-build-info.mjs && npm run typecheck:app && vite build --config vite.config.mts && node scripts/tauri-build-info.mjs --check --copy dist/app/build-info.json
